name: Engraved Stainless Steel Mug
description:
Premium Material:
  • Crafted from premium 18/8 stainless steel, this engraved mug is built for long-lasting durability and everyday use. 
  • The double-wall vacuum insulation helps maintain beverage temperature for hours while keeping the exterior sweat-free and comfortable to hold. 
  • Finished with a powder-coated surface for a sleek look and enhanced grip, the mug also features a BPA-free crystal-clear lid with a leak-resistant slider for added convenience.

 

Sizes & Dimensions:

The 14oz mug measures approximately 4.07 in (10.35 cm) in height and 3.94 in (10 cm) in top diameter, with an overall width of 5.08 in (12.9 cm) including the handle. Its compact yet spacious design makes it ideal for coffee, tea, hot chocolate, and other favorite beverages at home, in the office, or on the go. 

 

Engraving Technology:
  • Using high-quality laser engraving technology, the design is permanently etched onto the stainless steel surface for a clean, elegant finish that won’t fade, peel, or crack over time. 
  • Available with one-sided or double-sided engraving options, this mug delivers a personalized touch with exceptional detail and durability.

 

Functionality Use:
  • Designed for both hot and cold beverages, this insulated stainless steel mug keeps hot drinks for 4+ hours and cold for 9+ hours. 
  • The sturdy handle provides a comfortable grip, while the spill-resistant lid makes it perfect for commuting, camping, traveling, office work, or relaxing at home. 
  • Rust-resistant and waterproof construction ensures reliable daily performance.

 

Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:

This personalized engraved mug makes a thoughtful and practical gift for coffee lovers, tea enthusiasts, family members, friends, coworkers, teachers, or anyone who enjoys stylish drinkware. Perfect for birthdays, Father’s Day, Mother’s Day, Christmas, anniversaries, housewarmings, weddings, and other special occasions.
 

Specification:

Processing Time: 5-7 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly

Shipping Time: 7 – 15 working days average (US)
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
